thread:
marta: FYI customer 'acme-inc' opened a ticket ~09:12Z with recurring 502s on hosted API streaming endpoints. They see abrupt stream aborts and upstream resets. Ticket #8421. Can eng-sre triage?
kevin: Can you paste one failing request id + a quick curl reproducer? Any deploys around that time?
marta: Repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -v --http2 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"prompt":"<large>...","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Logs: `envoy upstream reset before response complete` and repeated `RST_STREAM` with code 0x2. Sample trace ids: trace-9a8b7c, trace-9a8b7d.
li: I saw a canary deploy of edge-authproxy v2.3 at 2025-07-14T09:09:57Z. Deploy-bot shows rollout finished just before the spike. Hypothesis: h2 keepalive/heartbeat mismatch between frontdoor and upstream causing mid-stream connection closure under long-lived streaming.
deploy-bot: deploy finished edge-authproxy v2.3 commit abc123 at 2025-07-14T09:09:57Z.
jonas: (customer) repro details: when we stream embeddings heavy requests, the client sees a 502 after ~28s. curl --http2 reproduce reliably in our staging. No immediate error body, just connection reset.
kevin: OK can we get a tcpdump or packet capture for one of the trace ids? Also need full envoy access log lines (x-envoy-upstream-service-time, response_flags).
marta: Pasted one envoy access log snippet: `2025-07-14T09:12:18Z envoy: req_id=trace-9a8b7c, response_code=502, response_flags=UPSTREAM_RESET, x-envoy-upstream-service-time=12345`
And upstream envoy error: `[warning] upstream reset before response complete (RST_STREAM)`
li: reproduction steps I used locally: run the same curl with `--http2` and a ~1MB payload, monitor ALPN h2 session. I saw `GOAWAY` from midproxy at ~26-29s and then `RST_STREAM` from the upstream. The midproxy keepalive_idle was 10s; the frontdoor expects a heartbeat at 30s -> mismatch.
kevin: Good catch. That would lead to midproxy thinking stream is idle and tearing down before the upstream finishes. Can you try increasing keepalive on a canary pool? Also check NGINX `proxy_read_timeout` / envoy `idle_timeout` values.
li: I applied a temporary config bump on two canary edge nodes: `keepalive_idle=30s`, `envoy.h2_idle_keepalive_interval=30s`, and `proxy_read_timeout=90s`.
marta: Monitoring now — within 3 minutes the 502 spike rate on canary decreased to baseline.
jonas: Confirmed from customer: streams resumed, no 502s for the same payloads after the canary change.
kevin: I'll roll the config globally but do a staged rollout. Also will add an automated check to detect h2 GOAWAY patterns in access logs.
li: Action items: 1) Increase default keepalive for streaming-tenant profiles to 30s 2) Add deployment checklist note for authproxy v2.x to validate keepalive settings 3) Add log alert for recurring `UPSTREAM_RESET` with `RST_STREAM`.
marta: I'll update ticket #8421 and mark current status as mitigated; customer verified fix. Please follow up with a short postmortem and a config change PR.
kevin: I'll create the incident note and assign a postmortem owner. Thanks for fast triage.
li: I'll prepare the PR to adjust defaults and include regression test that spins up long-lived h2 streams.
marta: Nice work — closing the support escalation once PR merges. :thumbsup:
